what: Removing the top-level step-5-entry.sh fence drops Step 5 telemetry-mark on the --self-review path
scenario_or_breakage: The plan deletes the unconditional entry fence and only calls step-5-review.sh inside the scripted loop. Self-review skips that loop but today still gets timing telemetry-mark --label "Step 5 — code review" from step-5-entry.sh. Self-review runs lose that mark and timing-ledger coverage regresses.
suggested_fix: Add a self-review-only foreground fence before the self-review banner that runs the same telemetry-mark (e.g. bash "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/larch-run.sh" python/cli.py timing telemetry-mark --implement-tmpdir "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR" --label "Step 5 — code review"), or extract a minimal shared mark helper both paths call.

what: Banner moves from orchestrator text into immediate-background child stdout
scenario_or_breakage: The scripted-loop banner includes dynamic-archetypes cap=N before review-and-fix KVs. Token-aware parsing targets named keys, so cap=N is unlikely to break STEP5_REVIEW_STATUS extraction, but human prose now mixes with machine KV output for the whole Step 5 wait.
